2608.19729.title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents
2608.19729.paper_summary: Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety. Training such agents to act safely is difficult, since safety and task success are distinct objectives, and safety arises only at a small number of safety-critical steps within a trajectory. Standard supervision is insufficient: imitating safe trajectories teaches behavior without explaining why it is safe, and contrasting arbitrary safe and unsafe trajectories mixes the safety signal with unrelated differences. We propose SafeBranch, a framework that aligns an embodied actor on safety through branch pairs constructed from the actor's own unsafe rollouts via environment rollback. SafeBranch rolls each unsafe rollout back to the safety-critical step that caused the violation, queries the actor for a safe alternative, and pairs the original action with the alternative so that the two branches differ only at that step. The trained actor acts safely at deployment with no critic in the loop. On IS-Bench, SafetyALFRED, and out-of-distribution variants with unseen tasks and objects, it handles safety reliably without sacrificing task success, achieving roughly ten times more safe successes than the untrained baseline on the unseen-object variant.
2608.19729.paper_summary_zh: 基於視覺-語言模型的具身代理可以完成指令任務，但在過程中往往違反安全限制，這個問題最近被框架為互動安全。訓練這些代理安全行動是困難的，因為安全和任務成功是不同的目標，而安全僅在軌跡中的少數安全關鍵步驟中出現。標準監督不足：模仿安全軌跡教會行為，但並未解釋為何它是安全的，對比任意的安全和不安全軌跡則將安全信號與無關的差異混合在一起。我們提出了SafeBranch，一個通過從代理自身的不安全展開中構建的分支對來對齊具身行為者的安全的框架。SafeBranch將每個不安全的展開回滾到導致違規的安全關鍵步驟，詢問代理安全的替代方案，並將原始行動與替代方案配對，使得兩個分支僅在該步驟上有所不同。訓練後的代理在部署時安全行動，且不需要評論者參與。在IS-Bench、SafetyALFRED和具有未見任務和物體的分佈外變體上，它可靠地處理安全問題，而不犧牲任務成功，在未見物體變體上實現了大約十倍於未訓練基線的安全成功。
